quotes.excerpt: the quicker we can recognize that they're running and hitting and we can get to our space

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the team's ongoing search for offensive flow
quotes.excerpt: we're still searching, we're still finding. We've had parts of the game where we look really good
quotes.quote: To be transparent, we're still searching, we're still finding. We've had parts of the game where we look really good with certain lineups and certain lineups we come in, we just can't find that flow. We get a sample size. I always say it feels better in a win, but we definitely have some things to clean up.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker admits the Suns are still searching for offensive flow: We have lineups that look good and lineups where we just cannot find that rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the importance of aggressive shot-making and spacing
quotes.excerpt: I think the pull-up Trey opens up everything. Even when you're not making it, it makes the defense come out
quotes.quote: I think the pull-up Trey opens up everything. Even when you're not making it, it makes the defense come out and make sure to make you a threat. So I'm going to keep letting them go when I get some space, to hopefully stress their defense out and open up other opportunities for my teammates.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on his shot selection: I am going to keep letting the pull up three go to stress the defense out and open up opportunities for my teammates.

structured.context: Devin Booker describes how his aggressive perimeter shooting helps create spacing and opportunities for his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the team's focus on low turnover numbers
quotes.excerpt: it's a possession game at the end of the day. We've been preaching that from the beginning
quotes.quote: It's important. It's a possession game at the end of the day. We've been preaching that from the beginning. We usually think about it as us getting extra possessions on the offense end, but getting a shot on goal every time down is important, too. We're at our best when we're getting a shot and we're giving an opportunity to at least get offensive rebound versus throwing the other team the ball and having to guard in transition.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker emphasizes the importance of limiting turnovers: It is a possession game at the end of the day. We are at our best when we get a shot up every time down.

structured.context: Devin Booker emphasizes the importance of valuing possessions and limiting turnovers to avoid transition defensive situations.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the necessity of lineup versatility and consistency
quotes.excerpt: we have a deep roster, we have a bunch of talent on the team, so it's our job
quotes.quote: It's important for flow, supporting the feel, seeing what lineups mesh well with each other and which ones don't. Every night it could be different. We have a deep roster, we have a bunch of talent on the team, so it's our job to make it a plug-and-play. We still need to keep our standards and what we do the same no matter who's on the court.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on the Suns rotation: We have a deep roster and a bunch of talent, so it is our job to make it plug and play regardless of who is on the court.

structured.context: Devin Booker discusses the need for the team to maintain high standards regardless of the specific lineup combinations used.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on Jordan Goodwin's impact off the bench
quotes.excerpt: when Jordan Goodwin gets in the game, you can almost feel the arena start getting ready for something
quotes.quote: When Jordan Goodwin gets in the game, you can almost feel the arena start getting ready for something. You can feel the energy in the gym and I always say he has a knack for the ball that I haven't seen from anybody through my career. I used to think he would just be lucky he'd be in the right spot at the right time, but that's taking away from his skill of reading the game, reading offensive rebounds, knowing who he's guarding, knowing their tendencies.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on Jordan Goodwin: You can feel the energy in the gym when he checks in. He has a knack for the ball that I have not seen from anybody in my career.

structured.context: Devin Booker praises Jordan Goodwin for his unique energy and high basketball IQ in reading the game.

quotes.speaker: Devin Booker
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker on the spacing benefits of Eric Gordon's shooting
quotes.excerpt: him and Eric Gordon have this two-man game that they've been exhausting for a couple years now
quotes.quote: Him and Eric Gordon have this two-man game that they've been exhausting for a couple years now. I've talked about it having to guard it in training camp, it's not easy. It's not Stephen Curry-like, but you definitely can't lose them. And he's hitting Eric Gordon, Eric Gordon's dropping it behind his back, and if it's not the first one, he might hit Eric Gordon and get it back again. So you have to be conditioned to guard them and you have to stay locked in.
quotes.social_post: Devin Booker on the Eric Gordon two man game: You have to be conditioned to guard them and you have to stay locked in because you definitely cannot lose them.

structured.context: Devin Booker discusses the difficulty of defending the two-man game involving Eric Gordon.
